# PicoSHA2

Unmodified MIT-licensed SHA-256 implementation.

- Upstream: https://github.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2
- Revision: `161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29`
- Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/okdshin/PicoSHA2/161cb3fc4170fa7a3eca9e582cebd27cc4d1fe29/picosha2.h
- SHA-256 of `picosha2.h`: `b13c180161ffac8d0adc81e033e493c409457c4d1258ab9781ac80579ba3bdd8`
- License: [LICENSE](LICENSE)

The private dependency is pinned and checked by CMake. Python uses hashlib.
